name: the first active session makes the person's did:webvh naming their Transit key, signs once, and writes their record and directory entry
a second session finds the identity and signs, writes and posts nothing
a step-up refusal writes nothing and leaves the identity pending with one sentence and Retry; Retry succeeds once signing works
a secret store that does not answer leaves the identity pending; one that stops between the two writes is finished without a second signature
at the first hub session the log is posted once, through that session, at its own path; a refusal is retried at the next session
without a DID domain or the engine bundle nothing is made, and nothing is signed
binding a computer refuses words that differ, a missing step-up and missing status lists, and makes nothing
after the words match and a fresh step-up, the binding names this computer's did:key and the person's did:webvh and verifies with the person key
a Markdown image in the checkout or published from this repository is bundled; any other address becomes a note
a missing or outside image stops the build with the page named
a mermaid diagram is drawn to an inline SVG that follows the theme and loads nothing
an MDX figure, components and import lines become plain HTML or a clear note, never JSX text
a raw HTML block keeps its picture and text but never its scripts, handlers or remote sources
the bundled guides with figures render them: three diagrams in the architecture overview, four screenshots in the README
unset, empty or [] settings give no model servers, no Open VSX address and an empty allow list
a JSON array of model servers gives one exact pattern per host and port, and a comma inside an address is kept
anything but a JSON array of strings is refused naming the setting, a comma-separated list included
http is accepted only to a loopback model server
a model server address with credentials, a query, a fragment, or a relative path is refused
more than 32 model servers are refused; 32 are accepted
STERLING_OPEN_VSX_URL adds its address; an invalid one is refused naming it
the same host listed twice gives one pattern, and no pattern ever holds a wildcard
the contribution returns exactly the patterns of the settings it was given, and Theia allows only those
a fresh step-up signs: login to the step-up role, sign with that token, then revoke it, in that order
acr missing or different, auth_time missing, too old or in the future: refused with the fix, and no OpenBao call
STERLING_STEPUP_ACR unset: signing is not set up on this site, and no OpenBao call
a refused step-up login is the same plain refusal and makes no sign call
a message that is not base64, or larger than 64 KiB, is refused without a call
a missing signing key (400 or 404) is refused plainly, and the step-up token is still revoked
generateWrappedDataKey returns the vault:vN: ciphertext from datakey/wrapped with the session token
unwrapDataKey refuses a malformed ciphertext without a call and decrypts a valid one with the session token, no step-up needed
personPublicKey reads the latest version of the person's own signing key with the session token, no step-up needed
personPublicKey: a missing key, a refusal and an answer that is not one ed25519 public key are plain refusals
local mode: long-term keys are not available on this computer, for every method, with no call
an inactive hosted session is refused not-ready for every method, with no call
an OpenBao that refuses or does not answer gives a plain refusal with no token, key or entity id
the RPC object has sign and generateWrappedDataKey, and no unwrapDataKey or personPublicKey
setPassword POSTs {data:{password}} to kv/data/users/<id>/<enc>/<enc> with the session token
getPassword reads data.data.password and answers undefined for a secret that is not there (404)
keys lists kv/metadata/users/<id>/<enc service>?list=true and decodes the names, skipping folders
findCredentials and findPassword read what keys lists
deletePassword DELETEs the metadata path and answers true, or false when the secret did not exist
without an active session every method rejects with the not-ready sentence and makes no OpenBao call
an OpenBao refusal or silence becomes a plain sentence with no secret, token or entity id
the unavailable store rejects all six methods with its reason and never resolves
hosted settings choose the OpenBao store without touching the keyring
local settings with a keytar that does not load choose unavailable; saving fails and memory is never used
local settings with a keytar that loads and answers choose the keyring, which round-trips a password
Theia's KeyStoreService binding is rebound to the delegating store, and a call before the choice is made waits for it
for 500 awkward strings the encoding round-trips, never repeats, and every segment is a safe single path part
secretPath has exactly four parts under users/<entity id>/ for any service and account
secretPath refuses an entity id that is not a UUID
a string with an unpaired surrogate is refused, so two such strings can never share a path
decodeSegment refuses a name the encoding could not have made
with STERLING_OPENBAO_ADDR unset or empty the session is local
hosted mode takes the defaults jwt, sterling-workbench, sterling-workbench-stepup, kv, transit and 300
http is accepted only to a loopback address
an address with a user name, a password, a query, a fragment or a path is refused
mount names, the roles, the step-up window and the session user are checked, each refusal naming its setting
the client sends X-Vault-Token only when a token is given, and JSON bodies round-trip
a 404 answers { status: 404 } without throwing
connection refused and a slow answer are unreachable
a request that fails before it is sent is unreachable, and nothing fires when its timeout would have
a 403 on login is refused with its status; a 500 is a bad response
an answer over 1 MiB or with invalid JSON is a bad response
error texts name the method, the path with users/<id> hidden, and the status, never a header or a body
over https the client trusts the CA in caFile, and without it the call is unreachable
a CA file that cannot be read is refused when the client is made, naming STERLING_OPENBAO_CA_FILE
the tracker gets the session start, then the time of the last use, as epoch milliseconds
only exactly "Bearer <session secret>" is answered; anything else is 401 with one word
the popup turns the state to idle-warned until the person next uses the page
every other /monitor path and method is 404, the operator's free-text message included; other paths are not answered at all
without the session secret or with the tracker off the state is off, use is ignored, and /monitor is 404 for everyone
no answer carries anything about the person or the secret
the tracker address is a pod IP in hosted mode only; loopback, a wildcard or unset is none, and a name stops the backend
the listener on the tracker address answers the tracker and 404s everything else, the workbench's own paths included
local mode: status is local with or without headers, session() is undefined and OpenBao is never called
hosted: a valid token with the matching person logs in once, reads the entity id, and goes active
a token observed before start is used as soon as start runs
no token within IDENTITY_TIMEOUT_MS is failed token-missing, and a later token recovers without Retry
the person check is case-insensitive
the email header, the token email or THEIACLOUD_SESSION_USER disagreeing is failed person-mismatch with no login
login refused (403) is failed store-refused; a new token does not leave it, and Retry runs the start path again
OpenBao unreachable is failed store-unreachable (connection refused, and a timeout), and Retry recovers
an entity id that is not a UUID is failed store-refused, and that token is revoked
an expired token and a token without a readable payload are ignored
in active, a token or email header naming someone else is ignored and never replaces the latest token
with a 20 s lease renew-self runs at about 10 s and again at half of each new lease
a refused renewal re-logs in once with the latest unexpired token; if that fails too the state is failed with its reason
a refused renewal with every forwarded token expired is failed token-missing, and a new token recovers
stop() from active revokes the token once and ends stopped with session() undefined
a revoke that fails or times out still ends stopped
stop() from identity or failed makes no OpenBao call
session().acr and authTime follow the latest observed token without a new login; status offers step-up when configured
stepUpUrl builds the same-origin /oauth2/start link and refuses any other origin
the fixture holds the site example and a site with model servers
every STERLING_* value the site-example render gives the pod is read by the workbench's settings readers
every STERLING_* value the model-servers render gives the pod is read by the workbench's settings readers
a verified refresh record for exactly the same commit vouches for the dashboard
missing, unverified, malformed or other-commit records never vouch
the documentation collection must be a non-empty list of complete pages
a catalogue keeps its evidence fields and archived entries, and says it is a catalogue
a catalogue entry cites its evidence and claims no holding: no quantity, status, asset DID or usage policy
only a catalogue may hold archived entries, and stored image digests are SHA-256 hex
links to the open area or its immediate opaque child and preserves unrelated metadata
two concurrent selections keep both source-scoped links
refuses unscoped, remote and malformed resource references before touching files
refuses linked components, malformed metadata and a same-length rewrite after the read
a capability record keeps its components, as labels and titles, for Get Started to list
the invalid sample returns the parser's own message as plain data
a valid sample is ready; a sample without a team file and an unknown id are missing
a missing engine bundle is "unavailable" when read, never an error when the reader is made
fixtures reached through a linked parent still load; a fixture linked out of its folder does not
bindBackendService binds one handler for the path that resolves the service lazily and returns refusals as values
